supersedes.premise_that_changed: D-219 removed the semantic head, so the 639872 human judgements that dominated the original 512/64/64 cost argument became zero; the scale question is now a compute and disk question

why_this_is_the_last_clean_moment: once E-06 reports a calibration NLL, changing the sample size becomes a results-driven change and is forbidden by the D-220 fairness floor

measurement_to_be_read.source: the 559 E-03 private house receipts already on the server

frozen_decision_rule.full_house_refusal_reason: about 20.6 GiB of RGB-D plus features against 25 GiB free on the shared 50 GiB data disk, while the P-02 formal paper raw still has to fit on the same disk; the front-end is explicitly not a paper contribution and may not consume the data budget of the experiment it serves

expansion_is_additive_not_a_rebuild.correction_to_plan_e07_text: the PLAN E-07 table said an expansion forces every RGB-D, feature, normalization, weight and temperature to be redone from zero; that is too conservative
expansion_is_additive_not_a_rebuild.actual_cost: splits are prefix-truncated in frozen hash order, so the existing 559 houses are exactly the leading entries and their RGB-D and 396-dimensional features are reused byte-for-byte; E-05 already reuses shards by digest
expansion_is_additive_not_a_rebuild.refit_cost: minutes of CPU on the existing features

storage_model_from_measured_e03_and_e05.source: E-03 stage directory about 1.1 GiB and E-05 features about 31 MiB over 559 successful houses

unchanged_boundaries: house level split before any image or label is seen
no house crosses train, calibration or audit
P0 and VM04 validation and test houses stay excluded
sampled houses are chosen by the frozen hash prefix, never by class, route yield or model effect
eight positions by four yaws per selected house
failed houses are retained without replacement
calibration selects only the checkpoint and the temperature
audit participates in no selection and is read once
P08 keeps 0.70, 0.70, 0.85 and 0.35 and may not be retuned
